remarks: Side by side duplex within 1/2 miles from Greenwich train station and Greenwich Avenue. Updated eat-in-kitchen with granite counter tops and stainless-steel appliances. Spacious living/dining room has a wood fireplace and sliding door to the private deck. Hardwood floors on the main level and carpeting on upper bedrooms. 2 large bedrooms with double closet spaces. All rooms are very specious and a plenty of natural lights through large windows and a sky light. A few cars will fit in a carport underneath the unit, and there is a patio space and backyard. Central AC. Freshly painted all interior walls.
